verdict.rationale: The Scribe convert API documents a timestamps granularity option where 'word' returns word-level timestamps and 'character' returns character-level timestamps per word. A community user corroborates that word timestamps are returned and used for alignment. Missing for 10: documentation of the per-word response schema (start/end fields), independent evidence on how precise the word alignment is.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording

citations.quote: 'word' provides word-level timestamps and 'character' provides character-level timestamps per word.
they also have to edit the text in the word timestamps, or the alignment goes off
